subject: SOC 2 recert + regional log slice / procurement timeline
messages:
From: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@horizonbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@horizonbank.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 recert: EU log slice & timing for renewal

Vanessa / Redwood team —

We're kicking our annual SOC 2 recert and Horizon Bank needs a few clarifications before we can sign the renewal amendment. Key asks: 1) Can Redwood produce a regional (EU) slice of audit logs covering the last 180 days in a streaming-friendly format (JSONL or parquet) with provenance metadata? 2) What's the lead time to stage that export and is there any ingestion/egress cost we should budget for? 3) We may need an additional 50 seats (monitoring / SSO users) effective with the renewal; who owns procurement and billing timelines?

We have a compliance window mid-November — ideally we get the artifact handover and the contract amendment completed by 11/18 so our internal auditors can review. Please let me know what information you need from our side (S3 destination, IAM user, PO timing).

Thanks,
Alex Tanner
Director, Security & Compliance
Horizon Bank

Attachment: none

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tanner <alex.tanner@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@horizonbank.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert: EU log slice & timing for renewal

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear asks. High-level plan and assumptions below. If that aligns, I'll loop in Legal / Billing for the amendment and Kimberly for pricing and timelines.

Summary plan (short):
- Export format: JSONL (primary) + parquet on request. We include per-event provenance fields (model_version, node_id, request_id, ts, region). Sample manifest attached.
- Regional slice: We can produce an EU-only slice for the last 180 days. For large volumes we deliver via a pre-signed S3 bucket link (multi-part upload) or a customer-provided bucket with a temporary IAM role.
- Lead time: For a standard 180-day window and a single service account, timeline is ~5 business days for extraction, verification, and MD5 manifest. If volume spikes / reprocessing required, add 3 business days.
- Costs: Egress + archive staging: estimated $1,200 - $3,400 depending on size (we'll provide a firm estimate once you share expected log volume or a sample query).
- Seats: We can add 50 monitoring seats on renewal effective date. Billing will pro-rate from the amendment execution date.

Next steps we need from Horizon:
- Preferred delivery method: (A) Redwood uploads to your S3 bucket via temporary role, or (B) Redwood provides S3 presigned upload links.
- Point of contact for the PO and billing (name / email and estimated PO lead time).
- Any special legal terms for data export (e.g., specific wording for EU data residency) — if yes, flag and I will loop Legal.

I'm attaching a concise "artifact index" (CSV) and an S3 upload checklist we usually share for recerts. I'll follow up internally to firm up pricing and a DocuSign amendment.

Onward —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: soc2_artifact_index.csv, s3_upload_instructions.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:20:47 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 recert: EU log slice & timing for renewal

Kim / Karthik — forwarding Horizon's ask. Quick notes and asks: 1) They want 180 days EU-only slice; delivery by 11/18 preferred (5 biz days is okay if we start extraction today). 2) Seat add: +50 monitoring seats, pro-rated on renewal. 3) They asked for an estimate for egress/staging.

Proposed commercial approach:
- Upgrade: +50 monitoring seats at list $8/seat/month with pro-rate for remaining term. Offer 10% standard renewal discount if they execute amendment by 11/12.
- Export fee: pass-through estimated band $1,000 - $3,500 — propose to include a not-to-exceed value of $3,500.
- Professional services: one-time effort for export verification (2-4 hours) — include as a $500 service line.

Operational notes for engineering export:
- Deliver JSONL compressed (gz) with manifest that includes event counts and per-file MD5s. Provide a sample of ~10,000 events first for schema sign-off.
- If Horizon wants parity parquet, we will convert after sign-off (add 2 business days).
- We'll provision a temporary role scoped to a single bucket prefix; security will log all actions.

Can you confirm pricing and if Legal needs to be looped for any special datastore wording? If you approve, I'll send a draft amendment + DocuSign link to Alex and Maria.

-- Vanessa

Alex / Maria —

Thanks — this is helpful. Per Vanessa's plan we've prepared a short renewal amendment that: (a) adds 50 monitoring seats (pro-rated from amendment execution), (b) includes a one-time export fee not-to-exceed $3,500 and a $500 verification service line, and (c) commits Redwood to deliver an EU-only 180-day JSONL slice with manifest within 5 business days of amendment execution.

What we need to finalize from Horizon:
1) Delivery method: confirm "Redwood will upload to Horizon S3 using temporary IAM role" or "Horizon prefers presigned uploads".
2) PO / billing contact and expected PO date.
3) Signature authority for the amendment (name / title / email).

If those three items are confirmed we will send DocuSign for signature. I've attached a redline-friendly amendment link here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ENVELOPE-abc123 — executing by 11/12 preserves the 10% renewal discount.

We will also send a 10k-event sample manifest to Horizon's CISO by EOD today for schema sign-off.

Best,
